$comment: Schema for protocol/evidence/hardware_verified_writes.json. Human-authored, append-only, outside generated/. Each entry records a REAL ACK + forced-readback write-transaction result observed on real hardware for one canonical RW field, via the deployed Settings UI (runRegisterWriteTransaction()/write_tx_snapshot correlation) -- never an HTTP-200-only or entity-SSE-only observation. tools/protocol/authoring/build_stage4_rw_inventory.js consults this file (alongside the pre-existing owner_write_override mechanism, a DIFFERENT purpose -- risk-acceptance to unblock a write path, not hardware-verification evidence) to promote a field from write-software-ready to write-hardware-verified. Validated by tools/protocol/lib/mini-schema.js -- see that file for exactly which keywords are supported.
